svg.title: How the job finds the agent and the skill
svg.desc: Top to bottom in four rows. First, the checkout, a slate row: actions/checkout puts the repository at the job's working directory. On pull_request that is the merge of the PR into main, so the agent, the skill and the workflow are the pull request's versions. A file list shows what is in the checkout: the workflow, reviewer.json, reviewer.md, the .kiro/skills/review-pr symlink into .agents/skills/review-pr, the real SKILL.md, and the guard hook script. Second, kiro-cli, a slate row: run from that directory with --agent reviewer, it discovers the workspace agent in .kiro/agents, the same way kiro-cli agent list does on a laptop. Nothing is installed or registered. Third, the reviewer agent, an amber row, loads reviewer.json in three parts: the model pin and the permission rules; the resources line, skill://.kiro/skills/review-pr/SKILL.md, which puts the skill's name in front of the model and not the file; and the prompt, reviewer.md, whose first instruction is to read .kiro/skills/review-pr/SKILL.md in full. That instruction opens the file, through the symlink, to the one copy in .agents/skills that Kiro, Claude Code and Codex all read. Fourth, the skill, a green row: it runs the six checks and writes .ai-review/review.md, and the job checks the shape and posts it with --comment. A note at the bottom says what lives where: everything in the checkout, Node and kiro-cli and gh on the runner, the key in a secret.
svg.text: How the job finds the agent and the skill
Nothing is installed or registered. Agent, brief and skill are files in the checkout. One line in the brief opens the skill.
actions/checkout puts the repository at the job's working directory, fetch-depth 0 so the diff against main is there.
On pull_request it is the merge of the PR into main: the PR's own agent, skill and workflow. On workflow_dispatch it is main.
Git stores the symlink as a symlink and the Ubuntu runner restores it. setup-node gives the guard hook its Node.
Workspace agents are found in .kiro/agents under the directory the command
runs in, the way kiro-cli agent list finds them on your laptop. No trust prompt.
--agent reviewer is the file in the checkout, nothing else.
Headless: every ask is a deny.
Puts the name review-pr in front of
the model. Not the file. The agent
in full and follow it exactly."
This line is what opens the file.
One copy. Claude Code reads it through .claude/skills, Codex through agents/openai.yaml. Edit it once, all three change.
Six checks, severities, template, as in section 4. One file, nothing else.
The job checks the shape, adds model, effort, commit, and posts it.
